values.event_label: Commit subject says 'Fix typos' but the change corrects the queue storage-slot arithmetic in normative pseudocode: slot stride changed from 2 to 3 per exit message and the four duplicated 'queue_storage_slot + 1' sload operands corrected to the intended '+1[0:32]' and '+2[0:16]' slots.
values.rationale: Materially corrects the specified storage layout an implementer would follow; the prior pseudocode contradicted the documented 3-slots-per-exit design, so this is a substantive correction despite the 'typos' subject.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 7eb97f37eb35: Update EIP-7002: Fix typos

values.event_label: Converts the mechanism from a stateful precompile to a deployed system contract: names VALIDATOR_EXIT_ADDRESS and SYSTEM_ADDRESS, defines three contract code paths (add exit, excess-exits getter, system process), removes the excess-return gas stipend, adds contract bytecode/deployment, and adds lightclient as author.
values.rationale: Major redesign of the core mechanism (402 insertions / 165 deletions) changing how clients implement and invoke it.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 35589d35c405: Update EIP-7002: convert to system contract

values.event_label: Removes trailing whitespace and fixes a stray '>' typo in the consensus-specs link.
values.rationale: Formatting and link-typo fixes only; no semantic content changed.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit fd8cb7912c60: Update EIP-7002: Fix typo on link to CL specs

values.event_label: Adds support for partial withdrawals (PR #8406): renames the mechanism from 'exits' to 'withdrawal requests' throughout (title, constants, contract name), adds the uint64 'amount' field to the request operation, and changes the predeploy address.
values.rationale: Extends normative functionality (partial withdrawals) and changes the operation's data structure and constants.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 967e58e57a90: Update EIP-7002: add support for partial withdrawals, rename exits (#8406)

values.event_label: Converts the EIP to use the EIP-7685 general-purpose execution-layer requests framework (PR #8469): adds 'requires: 7685' to the frontmatter, introduces WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_TYPE 0x01, replaces the standalone RLP block-body/header extension with EIP-7685 request encoding, and deletes the block-structure section.
values.rationale: Introduces an explicit cross-EIP dependency and restructures the request encoding and block integration around it.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 1536db76e9d7: Update EIP-7002: convert to use 7685 requests (#8469)

values.event_label: Fixes a leftover variable name in the fee-update pseudocode after the exits->withdrawal-requests rename ('exit' -> 'count').

values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 08e599b0f4dc: Update EIP-7002: Fix after renaming fields (exit->count)

values.event_label: Inhibits early use of the withdrawal-request queue (PR #8477): the deployed contract state now starts with an excess value that keeps the fee prohibitively high before the fork, with updated bytecode, a new deployment transaction, and a new predeploy address.

values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 72523ee3f865: Update EIP-7002: inhibit early use of queue (#8477)

values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit fed0965fc8c4: Update EIP-7002: make 7685 ordering explicit

values.event_label: "Simplify cl behavior": removes the requirement that "A additional processing step is be added to process_execution_payload to iterate over and process all requests", leaving each proposal free to choose how to extend ExecutionPayload and "how and when the request is processed".
values.rationale: Deletes a consensus-layer processing requirement and delegates the decision to each request-type proposal; changes what implementers must do.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: simplify cl behavior

values.eip_label: EIP-7685 · General purpose execution layer requests
values.event_label: Substantial specification build-out: renames the CamelCase types to snake_case (request_type / request_data / requests_root); adds a "Block structure" section appending a list of requests to the RLP block body; specifies requests_root computation with explicit compute_trie_root_from_indexed_data pseudocode; adds cross-type and intra-type ordering rationale sections; reflows the prose.
values.rationale: Defines the block body structure and the header commitment computation that were previously only described in prose; changes the data structures implementers must produce.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: General purpose execution layer requests

values.eip_label: EIP-7685 · General purpose execution layer requests
values.event_label: "Clarify intra-type ordering": drops the claim that lexicographical ordering of the opaque byte data would be the only valid scheme, keeping the same rule that intra-type order is determined by each request type individually.
values.rationale: Rationale-section rewording; the normative rule (intra-type order undefined here, set per request type) is unchanged.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: clarify intra-type ordering

values.eip_label: EIP-7685 · General purpose execution layer requests
values.event_label: Two typo fixes in the Rationale: names the opaque array explicitly ("the bytes of `request_data` array from second byte on") and fixes the ungrammatical "authority on their own unilaterally catalyze and action" to "authority on their own to unilaterally catalyze an action".
values.rationale: Grammar and wording fixes in non-normative rationale text.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: two typos in eip-7685.md

values.event_label: "Change requests hash to flat hash" (PR #8854): replaces the Merkle-Patricia trie requests_root with a flat commitment, renaming the header field to requests_hash and defining compute_requests_hash(list) = keccak256(rlp.encode([rlp.encode(req) for req in list])); also rewords the opaque-byte-array rationale ("transaction payload" -> "request payload").
values.rationale: Changes the header field name and the commitment algorithm; directly affects block validity computation.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: change requests hash to flat hash (#8854)

values.eip_label: EIP-7685 · General purpose execution layer requests
values.event_label: "Fix stale function name" (PR #8907): the assignment line still called compute_trie_root_from_indexed_data, removed by the previous commit; it now calls compute_requests_hash.
values.rationale: Repairs the normative pseudocode left inconsistent by the flat-hash change so that the specified computation is unambiguous; same logical update as commit 73629679.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: fix stale function name (#8907)

values.eip_label: EIP-7685 · General purpose execution layer requests
values.event_label: "Group requests into request-data": removes the block-body extension entirely (the header alone carries the commitment); redefines a `requests` object as request_type ++ request_data where request_data holds zero or more encoded request objects of that type; replaces the keccak256/RLP commitment with sha256(sha256(requests_0) ++ sha256(requests_1) ++ ...); updates the abstract and the ordering rationale accordingly.
values.rationale: Changes the block structure, the grouping of requests, and the hash function and construction of the header commitment.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: group requests into request-data

values.eip_label: EIP-7685 · General purpose execution layer requests
values.event_label: Removes a stray trailing backtick from the sha256 construction code block.
values.rationale: Markdown formatting fix only.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: fix typo

values.eip_label: EIP-7685 · General purpose execution layer requests
values.event_label: "Exclude empty requests data in commitment": items whose request_data is empty (length 1, type byte only) are skipped when building the intermediate hash list; the intermediate list must be ordered by request_type ascending; the pseudocode is corrected to hash digests (m.update(sha256(r).digest())) over a Sequence[bytes] block_requests; adds a rationale explaining that a block with no requests then commits to sha256("").
values.rationale: Changes which elements enter the commitment and therefore the value of requests_hash; directly affects block validity.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: exclude empty requests data in commitment

values.event_label: "Clarify the size of `request_type`": states that a `request_type` *byte* is prepended to request_data (previously unqualified); also fixes "will defines" to "will define".
values.rationale: Pins down the width of the type prefix, which implementations must encode and parse; materially clarifies the wire format.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7685: Clarify the size of `request_type`
